description:
#### This is the important one

Each Visitor Type names the role that approves it. That single field builds the approval workflow — a contractor can route to the System Manager while a candidate goes to HR, and a VIP can require a second approver.

Add your own types freely. The workflow regenerates itself, so nothing here is hardcoded.
name: VMS Configure Visitor Types
title: Decide who approves each kind of visitor
